# Style Guide

The voice payload of a persona or register — prose whose REGISTER IS THE CONTENT. The prose-voice doctrine (EPIC #348 gap analysis): voice documents attach byte-perfect via gmeow:exemplifiedBy (content-digested Documents carrying gmeow:hasAboutness gmeow:aboutnessEnacts — the document does not describe the voice, it IS the voice), never shredded into pseudo-quantified style triples. Style dimensions, when stated, are prose.
